prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1050; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating, consistent with a concussion mechanism for this type of event. Over the course of eight visits, the patient was managed with symptom monitoring, graded return-to-activity guidance, and cognitive and vestibular rest recommendations. Treatment followed a typical progression and tapered as symptoms steadily improved. Examination findings were mixed: certain vestibular and balance measures showed deficits that support the reported injury, while other neurological screening tests returned within normal limits. The patient also mentioned a minor strain involving the same region several years ago, which had fully resolved without lasting limitation and does not appear to have contributed to the current presentation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was cleared for graduated return to usual activities, with follow-up as needed.
